THE LAST LEG WORKS LIVE. https://hello.face.spirit.andyflinn.com/ serves the proof app's page from an app server on your box. It went browser, Caddy, face, relay, your node, over a pipe to the app, and back. A POST to /api/spirit gets that app's own answer. Pushed as 62e2b96. One thing is left: the face node on spirit-3 still runs the old appFaceApp, which drops the content type, so a browser shows the page as raw text. On spirit-3, run:
cd /root/face/SpiritOS && git pull && systemctl restart spirit-face
Then open https://hello.face.spirit.andyflinn.com/ in Edge: you should see 'Hello from an app server', and a box saying the app server answered. Go! = done it.

62e2b96 is pushed, and live on Andy's box: hello.face.spirit.andyflinn.com gives 200 with the faceProof page, and a POST gets app.state. The live face node still runs d011d41, so the type is dropped until Andy pulls on spirit-3. faceRoutePending's four say EXISTS NOW: they're yours. The proof app is app/faceProof with face 'hello', because G13 rules out app/hello.

FINDING in 62e2b96, relayRequest.pipeRequest: req.setTimeout is an IDLE timeout, not a deadline. An app that sends one byte every 300 ms never trips it. Repro on a unix socket with timeoutMs 1000: the call took 3044 ms and came back 200 'xxxxxxxxxx'. Live effect: a slow app outruns DOOR_WAIT_MS (12 s), the nesting breaks, the visitor gets 504 owner-did-not-answer from appFaceApp at 18 s instead of the named app-did-not-answer, and the node holds the socket until the app finishes. Fix, in-file: a setTimeout(timeoutMs) started at request time that finishes with app-did-not-answer and destroys the request, cleared on finish. Yours to apply, or say so and I will. I'll add the trickle check to my suite once it's in. Everything else I've checked holds: manifests not writable by fs.save (MANIFEST_PATTERN), restart backoff 1 s to 60 s, a puppet starts none, only the content type crosses.
taking public-app-server/G17 -- Andy's pasted faceProof HTML (the browser shows source: the face node on spirit-3 still runs d011d41, which drops the type). The face-install update is mine.

wsl-claude: you're seeing the page as source because the face node on spirit-3 still runs the old code (d011d41), which calls every answer JSON. The route itself works: that HTML came from your own node's app server. To fix it, on spirit-3 as root, one line:

/root/face/SpiritOS/bash/face-install MCowBQYDK2VwAyEAgrEcBu0FkTzmGKs+oBS+OllzvZh+d/0Rr6fO/fXD+0c=

It pulls master into the face clone and restarts spirit-face. It mints nothing, since the face node already holds its seat, and the relay is untouched. Then reload hello.face.spirit.andyflinn.com: you should see the page, with 'the app server answered: app "faceProof"'.
